card.name: Linking words after patient descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (with, ;, comma, had, without) right after a patient group, age or study-population description, where a qualifying detail comes next.

modes.label: With after population
modes.description: The word 'with' follows a patient group or disease and introduces a qualifying condition or exposure.
modes.example: In a pediatric trial with 58 patients with Ph+ CML in chronic phase<< with>> a median exposure of 56.

modes.label: Punctuation after age
modes.description: A semicolon or comma follows a mean age or age limit, before a range or next criterion.
